definition: Jonathan Ross is the founder and CEO of Groq & Co-creator of Google's TPU.
details: Initiated Google's Tensor Processing Unit (TPU) as a 20% project before founding Groq to build deterministic Language Processing Units (LPUs) for ultra-fast token generation. Jonathan Stephen Ross (born 17 November 1960) is an English broadcaster, television personality, comedian, and writer. He has presented television comedy chat shows, including BBC's Friday Night with Jonathan Ross (2001–2010) and ITV's The Jonathan Ross Show (2011–present). For the BBC show, he won three British Academy Television Awards for Best Entertainment Performance.

explainer.lead: Jonathan Ross is an English broadcaster and comedian (born 1960).

timeline.what: Jonathan Stephen Ross was born on 17 November 1960 in St Pancras, north London and raised in Leytonstone, east London.
Ross first appeared in a television advertisement for the breakfast cereal Kellogg's Rice Krispies in 1970, when he was 10 years old.

=== 1987–95: Channel X === Whilst on Solid Soul, he met fellow researcher Alan Marke, and the two devised what would prove to be a breakthrough hit for Ross in 1987, The Last Resort with Jonathan Ross.
Ross had not planned to be the show's host, but he presented the show from its debut in January 1987.
Ross and Raimi appeared together in a British television advertisement for Raimi's 1987 film Evil Dead II.
